title: OneDrive on the web: Copilot creates a presentation from a Word file
summary: Hold: removing the Copilot add-on licence does not necessarily remove every Copilot capability, because Microsoft documents Basic capabilities for some users without the add-on. The roadmap facts and licence-assignment controls are supported; the feature-specific documentation gaps were independently searched.
